title: 80 Scrub Oak Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 80 Scrub Oak Circle is a 6.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Located in the peaceful Lake District of WaterColor, this elegant coastal retreat offers a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. With spacious porches, a private carriage house, and quick access to Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club, 80 Scrub Oak Circle is ideal for families seeking relaxation and connection.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools With Up to 14 Passes Included Parking for 4 Cars (Garage Access Available) 6 Adult Bikes Included Propane Grill Exterior Shower Large Outdoor Balcony and Porches Located in the Heart of WaterColor’s Lake District 2-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Bike Ride to the WaterColor Beach Club via Western Lake Bridge 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Nestled in the tranquil Lake District of WaterColor, 80 Scrub Oak Circle is a beautifully designed vacation home offering a blend of luxury and comfort. Just a few blocks from the beloved Frog Pool, this home provides easy access to the Western Lake Bridge, Park District, and the WaterColor Beach Club. A welcoming screened-in back porch offers a peaceful space to relax with morning coffee or an evening drink, while the front porch invites guests to enjoy the serene natural surroundings. Inside, an open-concept living and dining area connects seamlessly to a well-equipped kitchen featuring Viking Professional Stainless-Steel Appliances, ample counter space, and seating for eight. The first-floor primary suite includes a king bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub, creating a restful retreat after a day at the beach. Upstairs, a mix of well-appointed bedrooms offers comfortable accommodations for family and friends, including a bunk room for children and multiple guest suites with private or shared baths. A separate carriage house provides additional privacy and flexibility, featuring a cozy living area, small kitchen, and queen bedroom with a private bath, ideal for a nanny, grandparents, or a couple seeking added seclusion. Designed for togetherness yet offering personal space, 80 Scrub Oak Circle is a true WaterColor retreat where relaxation and connection come naturally.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Laundry Area Half Bath Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Carriage House Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Life in WaterColor Guests of 80 Scrub Oak Circle enjoy exclusive access to the WaterColor Beach Club and all community pools, along with convenient proximity to Camp WaterColor, Seaside, and Western Lake’s scenic bridge. Whether relaxing on the porch, biking to the beach, or exploring the nearby shops and dining, every moment here captures the charm and coastal ease that define the WaterColor experience. Guest may rent an electric cart exclusively through The Electric Cart Company. Please note that WaterColor only allows one electric cart per home, and rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially during peak seasons.
